hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: A large tree trunk on the right side of the frame is positioned close to the curb, which may partially block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The continuous stone wall limits natural surveillance from adjacent properties, which can affect the perceived safety of the walkway.

hazards.name: Substandard Sidewalk Width
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the right is very narrow, likely under 4 feet, which makes it difficult for two people to pass or for wheelchair users to navigate comfortably.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the visible side-street junction on the left, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the main road.

hazards.name: Narrow and unmaintained buffer
hazards.description: The buffer between the sidewalk and the road is narrow and consists of uneven dirt and weeds, providing minimal protection and a potential tripping hazard if stepping off the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Between the sidewalk and the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the left is immediately adjacent to the travel lane with no physical or horizontal separation.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road along the stone wall

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation right up to the curb line limits sight lines between drivers and any pedestrians who might be on the road edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Background, lining the far side of the road
